title: Bond enthalpies: burning methane
caption: Breaking every bond in CH₄ + 2O₂ to make free atoms takes 2648 kJ; forming the bonds in CO₂ + 2H₂O releases 3466 kJ. ΔH = 2648 − 3466 = −818 kJ mol⁻¹, from mean bond enthalpies.
alt: Enthalpy diagram: reactants, then up 2648 kJ to separate atoms, then down 3466 kJ to products, which lie 818 kJ below the reactants.
description: Up 2648 kJ to C + 4H + 4O: bonds broken, 4 C–H and 2 O=O.
Down 3466 kJ to CO₂ + 2H₂O: bonds made, 2 C=O and 4 O–H.
